map.算法：基准厚度 = 0.32×电流（mm）；速度系数 = √(600/切割速度): Algorithm: baseline thickness = 0.32 times current (mm); speed coefficient = sqrt(600 / cutting speed); temperature coefficient = 1 + (arc temperature minus 20000) / 100000; maximum cut thickness = baseline thickness times speed coefficient times temperature coefficient; kerf width = nozzle aperture + 0.003 times current (mm); line energy = current times 120 / speed times 60 (J/mm, arc voltage estimated 120 V). Capability grading: thickness at or above 25 mm thick-plate efficient cutting, at or above 10 mm medium-plate cutting, otherwise thin-plate fine cutting.
map.例：电流 100A、速度 600mm/min、弧温 20000K、喷嘴 1.5m: Example: current 100 A, speed 600 mm/min, arc 20000 K, nozzle 1.5 mm gives baseline 32.0 mm, both coefficients 1, maximum thickness 32.0 mm, kerf 1.80 mm, line energy 1200 J/mm, judged as thick-plate efficient cutting. If current drops to 45 A, speed raised to 900 mm/min, arc 15000 K, nozzle 1.0 mm gives baseline 14.4 mm, speed coefficient 0.8165, temperature coefficient 0.95, maximum thickness 11.2 mm, kerf 1.14 mm, line energy 360 J/mm, judged as medium-plate cutting. Same 100 A supply slowing speed to 300 mm/min gives speed coefficient 1.4142, maximum thickness up to 45.3 mm, but line energy doubles to 2400 J/mm, heat-affected zone and dross risk clearly increase.

map.可切厚度大致与单位长度输入的热量成正比，而降速会同时增加加热时间并减小热散失比例: Cuttable thickness is roughly proportional to the heat input per unit length, while slowing down simultaneously increases heating time and reduces the heat-loss share; actual growth is faster than linear but slower than proportional, so the sqrt relation is an empirical fit. Specific models should refer to the manufacturer cutting table; this result is only a preliminary estimate.
map.线能量高有什么后果？: What are the consequences of high line energy?
map.线能量越高，热影响区越宽，切口上缘易出现圆角、挂渣与熔化塌边，薄板还会明显翘曲变: Higher line energy means a wider heat-affected zone; the cut upper edge easily gets rounded corners, dross and melt collapse, and thin plates clearly warp and deform. For verticality and narrow kerf, raise speed and choose a small-aperture nozzle rather than simply increasing current.
